claim_tested: RTT109 acetyltransferase catalysis is required for PRC2-repressed chromatin
key_finding: rtt109 D145A and rtt109 D145A-DD304-305AA at csr-1 in delta-rtt109 fail to rescue H3K27me3; loss equal to or greater than delta-rtt109; wild-type rtt109-3xflag rescues
context: N. crassa, vegetative hyphae, H3K27me3 ChIP-seq + western
confidence_and_limitations: High for the requirement. Authors note catalytic-dead protein levels were reduced, so a protein-abundance contribution is not formally excluded.

direction: refutes H3K56ac as the relevant product
claim_tested: H3K56ac is the product that supports PRC2-repressed chromatin
key_finding: hH3 K56R and hH3 K56Q do not phenocopy the delta-rtt109 H3K27me3 defect; global H3K27me3 unchanged by western; only modest bidirectional ChIP-seq profile shifts
confidence_and_limitations: High. Both alleles are MMS-hypersensitive, an internal positive control that they perturb H3K56 function.

claim_tested: The NAF-2 (Vps75) dependent route produces the relevant mark
key_finding: NAF-2 is the top RTT109 co-IP LC-MS/MS interactor of 11; AlphaFold3 ipTM 0.67 with 20 contacts between RTT109 420-480 and NAF-2 290-330; delta-naf-2 does not reproduce the H3K27me3 defect
context: N. crassa, FLAG co-IP and deletion strains
confidence_and_limitations: High for dispensability. The interaction is real but uncoupled from the phenotype.

claim_tested: ASF-1 partners with RTT109 in N. crassa
key_finding: No RTT109-ASF-1 interaction detected; authors attribute this to the known difficulty of detecting Asf1-Rtt109 without crosslinking in yeast
confidence_and_limitations: Low. A negative co-IP under non-crosslinking conditions does not exclude the interaction.

evidence_type: coverage audit of the primary article (this work)
claim_tested: An alternative acetylation site was identified
key_finding: Zero occurrences of H3K9ac, H3K14ac, H3K18ac, H3K23ac or H3K27ac in 120,120 characters of full text; no acetylome or histone-PTM mass spectrometry reported
context: Text mining of PMCID 13652317 via NCBI efetch
confidence_and_limitations: High as a statement about the article. The alternative substrate is defined only by exclusion.

claim_tested: N. crassa RTT109 is an H3K56 acetyltransferase
key_finding: RTT109 is the H3K56 acetyltransferase in N. crassa and H3K56ac is required for the small-RNA biogenesis (quelling) pathway
confidence_and_limitations: High for the MF assignment. Establishes H3K56ac activity in this organism, in a process distinct from PRC2 silencing.

key_finding: Sordaria macrospora rtt109 phenotypes consistent with H3K56ac loss
context: Sordaria macrospora, a close Sordariomycete relative
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Ortholog evidence, used for corroboration only.

claim_tested: Chaperone identity selects the Rtt109 site
key_finding: Vps75-bound Rtt109 acetylates H3K9 and H3K27; Asf1-bound Rtt109 acetylates H3K56
context: S. cerevisiae, recombinant proteins in vitro
confidence_and_limitations: High in yeast, but in vitro and not transferable: the N. crassa Vps75 homolog NAF-2 is dispensable for the phenotype.

claim_tested: Rtt109 site selection has structural determinants
key_finding: Rtt109-Vps75 structure and specificity analysis define the chaperone interface and the K290 autoacetylation requirement
context: S. cerevisiae, crystallography and in vitro HAT
confidence_and_limitations: High in yeast. Supplies the determinant list used in the mapping below.

claim_tested: Specificity determinants constrain which site N. crassa RTT109 can use
key_finding: Q7S1R7 vs Q07794: 34.2% identity over 371 aligned columns. Catalysis 6/6 identical (D145, R192, Y197, W226, D304, D305), autoacetylation K307 identical, acetyl-CoA contacts 4/7 identical with R97/R101 unaligned, Vps75 interface 4/9 non-conservative
confidence_and_limitations: High for the catalytic core: the mapping blindly recovers D145, D304 and D305, the exact residues mutated in PMID 42832562. The donor-side determinants are shared by all candidate reactions and so carry no site information.

claim_tested: Candidate non-H3K56 sites can be ranked by surrounding sequence context
key_finding: N. crassa H3 (P07041) and S. cerevisiae H3 (P61830) are 136 aa, 94.9% identical, no indels; the +/-6 windows at K4, K9, K14, K18, K23, K27 and K36 are character-for-character identical; only the K56 window differs (F54Y)
confidence_and_limitations: High. The substrate side carries zero discriminating information between the two species.

claim_tested: A predicted structure can localise the determinants
key_finding: AF-Q7S1R7-F1 v6 global pLDDT 69.1; catalytic/autoacetylation mean 93.9; acetyl-CoA contacts mean 93.8; Vps75-equivalent mean 83.7; C-terminal Asf1-equivalent mean 47.3 (residues 600-630 mean 33.6); D305 CG to K307 NZ 3.6 A
context: AlphaFold DB prediction, no experimental N. crassa RTT109 structure exists
confidence_and_limitations: Catalytic core assignments reliable; the C-terminal Asf1-tail assignment is not, given pLDDT below 50.

claim_tested: Current GO annotation reflects the N. crassa evidence
key_finding: All 9 QuickGO annotations on Q7S1R7 are IEA or IBA with no experimental evidence code, including GO:0032931 histone H3K56 acetyltransferase activity (IBA, GO_Central)
confidence_and_limitations: High as a database snapshot. Experimental N. crassa evidence from PMID 24554705 and PMID 42832562 is not yet captured.
